policy_name: Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法)
issuing_authority: Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC), jointly with the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security and National Radio and Television Administration
regulatory_regime: PRC cyberspace/internet information service regulation (CAC departmental rules under the Cybersecurity Law, Data Security Law and Personal Information Protection Law)
geo_constraints: Generative AI services provided to the public within the territory of the PRC, including services from outside the PRC offered to users in the PRC (Art. 2, Art. 20)

locale_context.regulation: Binding departmental rules · service-provider obligations with filing/security assessment
locale_context.culture: PRC state-led, security-first internet governance: content security, 'core socialist values', social stability and national security alongside development; agile, sector-specific CAC rules with filing/registration and labelling duties.

key_dates.event: CAC releases draft for public comment
Adopted at the CAC 2023 12th office meeting (per LawRefBook mirror file date; not verified on cac.gov.cn)
Published as joint order of seven departments
Labeling obligations under Art. 12 operationalised by the AIGC Labeling Measures and mandatory standard GB 45438-2025
Amended Cybersecurity Law (one of the parent laws cited in Art. 1/21) takes effect, adding a state AI support/governance article (Art. 20) and higher penalties

version: Joint order of CAC, NDRC, MOE, MOST, MIIT, MPS, NRTA (2023), No. 15 (order number from compiler knowledge, not verified against fetched source)
covered_entities: generative AI service providers (including via APIs)
covered_systems: generative AI technology: models and related technologies capable of generating text, images, audio, video and other content
covered_activities: providing generative AI services to the public in the PRC
exceptions: R&D and application by industry organisations, enterprises, education and research institutions, public cultural institutions and professional bodies that do not provide services to the domestic public (Art. 2 para. 3)
News publishing, film/TV production and artistic creation where the State has separate rules (Art. 2 para. 2)
conditions: Security assessment and algorithm filing apply to services with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity (Art. 17)
Personal-information obligations apply where personal information is involved (Art. 7(3), Art. 9, Art. 11)
objective: Promote the healthy development and standardised application of generative AI while safeguarding national security, the social public interest and the lawful rights of citizens and organisations, via inclusive-prudent, categorised and graded supervision.
principles: equal emphasis on development and security
accuracy and reliability of generated content
parent_policy: Cybersecurity Law of the PRC; Data Security Law; Personal Information Protection Law; Law on Progress of Science and Technology

related_policies.policy: Cybersecurity Law of the PRC (as amended 2025-10-28, effective 2026-01-01; new Art. 20 on AI)
Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC
Interim Measures for the Management of AI Anthropomorphic Interaction Services (人工智能拟人化互动服务管理暂行办法, 2026, effective 2026-07-15)
TC260-003 Basic Security Requirements for Generative AI Services (2024) / GB/T 45654-2025

conflict_rule: Where the State has separate provisions for news publishing, film/TV production or artistic creation those prevail (Art. 2); penalties follow the Cybersecurity, Data Security, PIPL and Science & Technology Progress laws, with the Measures' own warnings/suspension only where laws are silent (Art. 21); licensing requirements under laws/administrative regulations still apply (Art. 23).

record_provenance.notes: cac.gov.cn and gov.cn were not reachable from the compilation environment, so the Chinese clause text was taken from the LawRefBook/Laws GitHub mirror of the official text; it matches the compiler's knowledge of the official wording but should be re-checked against cac.gov.cn. The source_uri and the order number (No. 15) are from compiler knowledge and were not fetched. English translations are the compiler's own (Claude), not official; no official English version exists. No amendment to the Measures was found as of Nov 2026. The 2025 Cybersecurity Law amendment (adopted 2025-10-28, effective 2026-01-01) adds Art. 20 on state support for AI research, ethics norms, risk monitoring/assessment and safety supervision, and raises penalties under the parent law used by Art. 21; it does not amend the Measures' text. A national AI law has been discussed but no adopted text was verified.

clauses.original_text: 提供和使用生成式人工智能服务，应当遵守法律、行政法规，尊重社会公德和伦理道德，遵守以下规定：（一）坚持社会主义核心价值观，不得生成煽动颠覆国家政权、推翻社会主义制度，危害国家安全和利益、损害国家形象，煽动分裂国家、破坏国家统一和社会稳定，宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义，宣扬民族仇恨、民族歧视，暴力、淫秽色情，以及虚假有害信息等法律、行政法规禁止的内容；
clauses.translated_text: The provision and use of generative AI services shall comply with laws and administrative regulations, respect social morality and ethics, and observe the following: (1) uphold the core socialist values, and not generate content prohibited by laws and administrative regulations such as incitement to subvert state power or overthrow the socialist system, endangering national security and interests, harming the national image, inciting secession or undermining national unity and social stability, promoting terrorism or extremism, promoting ethnic hatred or discrimination, violence, obscenity and pornography, or false and harmful information; [translation: compiler's own]
clauses.actor: providers and users of generative AI services
clauses.object: content prohibited by laws and administrative regulations
clauses.requirement: do not generate prohibited content (subversion, threats to national security, terrorism/extremism, ethnic hatred, violence, pornography, false and harmful information)
clauses.purpose: protect national security, social stability and the information environment
clauses.affected_asset: national security, social order, public information ecosystem
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI services offered to the public in the PRC
clauses.interpretation_notes: Applies to both providers and users. 'False and harmful information' and political-content categories are broad and defined by reference to other laws.

clauses.original_text: （二）在算法设计、训练数据选择、模型生成和优化、提供服务等过程中，采取有效措施防止产生民族、信仰、国别、地域、性别、年龄、职业、健康等歧视；
clauses.translated_text: (2) In algorithm design, training data selection, model generation and optimisation, and service provision, take effective measures to prevent discrimination on the basis of ethnicity, belief, country, region, sex, age, occupation, health, etc.; [translation: compiler's own]
clauses.actor: providers (and users) of generative AI services
clauses.object: discrimination by ethnicity, belief, nationality, region, sex, age, occupation, health
clauses.requirement: prevent discriminatory outputs across the lifecycle (design, data selection, training, optimisation, provision)
clauses.affected_asset: equal treatment of individuals and groups
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI services offered to the public in the PRC
clauses.interpretation_notes: Lifecycle-wide 'effective measures' obligation; no technical standard named in the Measures themselves (TC260 security requirements give practice detail).

clauses.original_text: 生成式人工智能服务提供者（以下称提供者）应当依法开展预训练、优化训练等训练数据处理活动，遵守以下规定：（一）使用具有合法来源的数据和基础模型；（二）涉及知识产权的，不得侵害他人依法享有的知识产权；（三）涉及个人信息的，应当取得个人同意或者符合法律、行政法规规定的其他情形；（四）采取有效措施提高训练数据质量，增强训练数据的真实性、准确性、客观性、多样性；…
clauses.translated_text: Generative AI service providers ("providers") shall carry out pre-training, optimisation training and other training-data processing activities in accordance with law and observe the following: (1) use data and foundation models with lawful sources; (2) where intellectual property is involved, not infringe IP rights lawfully enjoyed by others; (3) where personal information is involved, obtain individual consent or meet other circumstances provided by laws and administrative regulations; (4) take effective measures to improve training-data quality and enhance its truthfulness, accuracy, objectivity and diversity; … [translation: compiler's own]
clauses.object: pre-training and fine-tuning data and foundation models
clauses.requirement: lawful data/model sources, no IP infringement, consent or other legal basis for personal data, effective measures for training-data quality
clauses.purpose: data legality, IP protection, privacy and output quality
clauses.affected_asset: intellectual property, personal information, data quality
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI models used to provide services in the PRC
clauses.interpretation_notes: Item (5) (truncated) cross-refers to other requirements of the Cybersecurity, Data Security and PIPL laws and regulators.

clauses.original_text: 提供者应当按照《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》对图片、视频等生成内容进行标识。
clauses.translated_text: Providers shall label generated content such as images and videos in accordance with the Provisions on the Administration of Deep Synthesis of Internet Information Services. [translation: compiler's own]
clauses.object: generated images, videos and other content
clauses.requirement: label AI-generated content per the Deep Synthesis Provisions
clauses.purpose: transparency about AI-generated content, prevent public confusion
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI services offered to the public in the PRC
clauses.interpretation_notes: Cross-reference to CN_Deep_Synthesis_2022 Arts. 16-18; detailed explicit/implicit label rules since 2025-09-01 in CN_AIGC_Labeling_2025 and GB 45438-2025.

clauses.original_text: 提供者发现违法内容的，应当及时采取停止生成、停止传输、消除等处置措施，采取模型优化训练等措施进行整改，并向有关主管部门报告。提供者发现使用者利用生成式人工智能服务从事违法活动的，应当依法依约采取警示、限制功能、暂停或者终止向其提供服务等处置措施，保存有关记录，并向有关主管部门报告。
clauses.translated_text: Where providers discover illegal content, they shall promptly take measures such as stopping generation, stopping transmission and deletion, take measures such as model optimisation training to rectify, and report to the relevant competent department. Where providers discover users using generative AI services to engage in illegal activities, they shall, in accordance with law and agreement, take measures such as warnings, restricting functions, or suspending or terminating service, retain relevant records, and report to the relevant competent department. [translation: compiler's own]
clauses.action: stop generation/transmission, remediate model, report; sanction users
clauses.object: illegal content and illegal user activity
clauses.requirement: incident handling: takedown, model rectification, user sanctions, record retention and reporting
clauses.condition: upon discovery of illegal content or illegal user activity
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI services offered to the public in the PRC
clauses.interpretation_notes: Notable for requiring model-level remediation ('model optimisation training') rather than only output filtering.

clauses.original_text: 提供具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的生成式人工智能服务的，应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并按照《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续。
clauses.translated_text: Those providing generative AI services with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity shall carry out security assessments in accordance with relevant State provisions and complete algorithm filing, modification and cancellation procedures in accordance with the Provisions on the Administration of Algorithmic Recommendation for Internet Information Services. [translation: compiler's own]
clauses.action: conduct security assessment and file algorithm
clauses.condition: service has public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity
clauses.applicable_systems: generative AI services with public-opinion attributes or social-mobilisation capacity
clauses.interpretation_notes: In practice this underpins CAC's generative AI service filing ('large model filing') regime; the trigger criterion is not defined in the Measures.
